name: Meteoric Resources Limited
summary: Meteoric Resources Limited, together with its subsidiaries, explores and develops mineral tenements in Brazil. The company explores for rare earth minerals, bauxite, clay, uranium, zirconium, and leucite. Its flagship property is the Caldeira rare earth ionic clay project comprising 77 mining and exploration licenses covering an area of approximately 193 square kilometers located between the cities of Caldas, Poços de Caldas, and Andrades in the southwest region of the state of Minas Gerais in Brazil.
